alternative_city_role: The paired donor_fact_value is that donor person's sourced birthplace. On the target question it is an alternative continuation, not the target person's birthplace and not a training label.

answer_prefix.retain_name: strip the first matching prefix from author_span; Jane Morrison keeps that name rather than the source answer's 'She'

city_span.rule: Tokenize prompt + prefix + city with add_special_tokens=True and offsets. The scored span is every token overlapping the city characters, from that first overlapping token through the end of the sequence. No EOS and no padding.
city_span.shared_prefix: Tokens before the first city-overlapping token must be identical, and both cities must start at that same index. A shared first city token, such as ' New' in New York City versus New Orleans, stays inside both spans. The full sequences must still differ somewhere inside the span.
city_span.boundary_failure: exclude the cluster from nomination and record the failure

score.sum: sum of conditional log-probs over the full city span
score.positive_M: under the fixed prefix the model assigns higher average token log-prob to the target city
score.positive_patch_effect: the target city's relative advantage fell; this is not forgetting success
also_report: mean and sum for each city
mean change of each city separately

anchor.name: question_mark
anchor.rule: Exactly one prompt token whose piece is '?'. The hook replaces only that position, including when the scored sequence continues into the answer prefix.

layer_map.layer_31_vector: forward-hook output of layers[31] before the final RMSNorm; this is not hidden_states[32]
layer_map.hidden_states_32: final RMSNorm output; not a patch site
layer_map.patch_strength: full residual replacement at the question-mark position only

nomination.median: sort ascending; odd count takes the center; even count takes the mean of the two centers
nomination.tie_break: higher median first, then lower layer index

noise.epsilon: standard normal float32 on a CPU generator
noise.h_source: unpatched target-city scoring forward at the recipient question mark
noise.a_minus_source: prompt-only donor forward at the donor question mark
noise.seed_formula: seed + 10007 * layer + 1000003 * pair_index + (1000000007 if group == retain else 0)

shuffle.algorithm: random.Random(20261111).shuffle on donor-01..donor-10; the first shuffle is a derangement
shuffle.does_not_change: the question, prefix, target city, or alternative city used to compute M

retain.author_span: literal text between 'Where was ' and ' born?'

expected_probes.author_span: the renowned war genre writer Rhoda Mbalazi

generation.input: question prompt only; no answer prefix
generation.when: baseline for every forget and retain probe; after S is frozen, one donor, one noise seed 0, and one shuffle generation on each confirmation probe and each retain probe
generation.priority: both target and another closed city -> human_review; else target phrase -> target_correct; else another closed city -> wrong_fact; else refusal phrase -> refusal; else hit the token cap -> truncated; else not_mentioned
generation.target_match: the target city or a registered alias anywhere in the decoded text, including mid-sentence
generation.match: full phrase with non-word boundaries on both sides; longer phrases are not replaced by shorter prefixes

tolerances.target_and_alternative_question_mark_sit: recorded separately; noise on each continuation uses that continuation's own unpatched question-mark residual. A nonzero difference, which can come from different SDPA kernels on different lengths, does not fail the read gate.

downstream_check.probe: set the first residual coordinate to 0 if it is nonzero, otherwise set it to 1
downstream_check.pass_if: watched next-layer input max abs diff > 0

confirmation_claim.donor_specific_positive_clusters: at least 3 of the 4 confirmation clusters have M_before > 0 and donor_specific > 0
confirmation_claim.selectivity_did_median: median over M-eligible confirmation clusters of (donor_specific_forget - mean retain donor_specific) > 0
confirmation_claim.retain_required: at least one retain probe with M_before > 0; otherwise selectivity is BLOCKED

source_gate.pass_if: exactly one preferred-or-normal P19 and the English label equals donor_fact_value
